articles.title: Who is Ben Treloar? Australian umpire set to officiate in Ranji Trophy
articles.summary: Australian umpire Ben Treloar will officiate in two Ranji Trophy matches in India, while Indian umpire Parashar Joshi will travel to Australia to officiate in two Sheffield Shield matches and one One Day Cup game as part of the CA-BCCI Umpire Exchange Program..

articles.title: ERD Punjab Lecturer result 2026 declared for 1,013 posts: Check direct link to download subject-wise merit list PDF here
articles.summary: The Education Recruitment Directorate (ERD), Punjab, has announced the Lecturer result 2026 on October 19. Candidates can access subject-wise result PDFs at erd.punjab.gov.in and check their roll numbers.

articles.title: Uttarakhand NEET UG counselling 2026: 145 MBBS and BDS seats vacant, check college-wise list
articles.summary: Uttarakhand NEET UG counselling 2026: Uttarakhand has 145 vacant medical and dental seats after three NEET UG counselling rounds, including 116 MBBS and 29 BDS seats. The state medical university has scheduled a stray vacancy round, with registration, fee payment and choice filling closing at 5 pm on October 21, 2026.

articles.title: KEA VAO result 2026 out for 572 posts, download merit list PDF and check next steps
articles.summary: KEA VAO Result 2026: KEA has declared the VAO Result 2026 on October 19 for recruitment to 572 vacancies in Karnataka. Candidates can access the merit list and scorecard through cetonline.karnataka.gov.in.

articles.title: UPSC CDS 2 result 2026 declared for 451 posts, check written examination result at upsc.gov.in
articles.summary: UPSC CDS 2 Result 2026: UPSC declared the CDS 2 2026 written examination result on October 19, 2026, for the examination held on September 13. The recruitment covers 451 vacancies across the Indian Military Academy, Indian Naval Academy, Air Force Academy and Officers’ Training Academy.

articles.title: ‘Jailer 2’: Action director confirms Mohanlal performed climax car scene himself
articles.summary: Mohanlal's limited screen time in 'Jailer 2' has led to discussions among fans and industry professionals. Action director Chethan confirmed that Mohanlal performed the climax car scene himself, dismissing rumors of a body double.

articles.title: Tiger granted police protection, bodyguards after firing incident
articles.summary: Tiger Shroff was recently granted police protection after a firing incident involving the Lawrence Bishnoi gang. The absence of security made him an easy target during the attack.

articles.title: Suriya, Nazriya Nazim feature in ‘Aeroplane’, second song from ‘Scene’
articles.summary: The filmmakers of Suriya’s upcoming action-comedy film ‘Scene’ have released the second song titled ‘Aeroplane’. This high-energy romantic track features Suriya and Nazriya Nazim and showcases their on-screen chemistry.

articles.title: Vijay Deverakonda and Rashmika Mandanna starrer sees 28% Monday drop
